scope: G8 central-bank market-pricing only; no proxy, no interpolation, no publication authorization.

certification_standard.relative_comparability: All eight currencies must pass the same no-proxy, homogeneous-basis and PIT requirements before the 28-cross OIS layer can vote.

AUD.source_identity: ASX Futures end-of-day settlement, 30 Day Interbank Cash Rate futures (IB)
AUD.tenor_mapping: Direct deterministic quarterly futures buckets; no interpolation.
AUD.historical_availability: Official daily settlement history used for current, prior session and certified weekly reference.
AUD.pit_freshness: Validated in runtime; source-specific T-5 reference and change fields present.
AUD.licensing_reproducibility: Official exchange settlement source; receipt path implemented in existing ASX adapter.

CAD.source_identity: Montréal Exchange public Market Review, Three-Month CORRA Futures (CRA)
CAD.tenor_mapping: Direct Dec-26 / Mar-27 / Sep-27 quarterly buckets; no interpolation.
CAD.historical_availability: Official Market Review IDs 6187, 6191 and 6192 provide certified weekly, T-1 and current observations.
CAD.pit_freshness: Validated in runtime; changes are computed from same-basis official records.
CAD.licensing_reproducibility: Public official exchange records; existing MX adapter stores review identifiers.

GBP.source_identity: Bank of England estimated sterling OIS forward curve based on SONIA
GBP.quotation_unit: Annualised continuously compounded instantaneous forward rate, percent
GBP.tenor_mapping: Exact official 3M, 6M and 12M short-end forward-curve columns; no interpolation.
GBP.historical_availability: Official daily archive workbook provides 22 Sep, 28 Sep and 29 Sep rows.
GBP.pit_freshness: Validated in runtime; 22 Sep is the homogeneous five-business-day reference.
GBP.licensing_reproducibility: Public central-bank archive; existing BoE adapter records workbook, sheet and run provenance.

JPY.source_identity: Tokyo Financial Exchange, Three-month TONA Futures
JPY.tenor_mapping: Direct Dec-26 / Mar-27 / Sep-27 quarterly buckets; no interpolation.
JPY.historical_availability: Official TFX observations exist for 24 Sep, 28 Sep and 29 Sep.
JPY.pit_freshness: Validated in runtime; nearest eligible official session on or before target is used for weekly reference.
JPY.licensing_reproducibility: Official exchange observations; existing TFX adapter preserves source-specific reference rule.

USD.source_identity: CME/CBOT, 30-Day Federal Funds Futures (ZQ); CME also lists SOFR products but they are not a substitute without a separately approved mapping.
USD.quotation_unit: 100 minus average effective federal funds rate, percent
USD.tenor_mapping: Would require frozen same-contract ZQ buckets mapped deterministically to 3M/6M/12M; no mapping is activated.
USD.historical_availability: Current snapshot and T-1 reconstruction were validated; homogeneous official T-5 settlement receipt remains unavailable to this environment.
USD.pit_freshness: FAIL_CLOSED: no reproducible source-defined T-5 receipt/publication timing for all required contracts.
USD.licensing_reproducibility: CME states daily settlements and historical data are accessed through DataMine; the required historical settlement access is Datamine-routed/blocked here.
USD.activation_condition: Record official same-basis ZQ settlements for current, T-1 and source-specific T-5, with publication timestamp/receipt and immutable hashes; then run double materialization.

EUR.tenor_mapping: Would require frozen FST3 contract buckets for 3M/6M/12M; no mapping is activated.
EUR.historical_availability: The product endpoint documents daily-settlement methodology and displays current/delayed quotes; free daily statistics for target dates do not include contract settlement prices.
EUR.pit_freshness: FAIL_CLOSED: historical query parameters did not reproduce target-date settlement snapshots or publication times.
EUR.licensing_reproducibility: An authorized Eurex settlement-history entitlement/export is required for exact historical EOD records.
EUR.activation_condition: Obtain entitled or public official FST3 EOD settlement records for current, T-1 and source-specific T-5 with contract identifiers, timestamps and hashes; then run double materialization.

CHF.source_identity: ICE Futures Europe, Three Month SARON Index Futures (SA3)
CHF.tenor_mapping: Would require frozen SA3 quarterly buckets for 3M/6M/12M; no mapping is activated.
CHF.historical_availability: Public ICE expiry page provides contract metadata and final settlement dates, not daily historical EOD settlement observations.
CHF.pit_freshness: FAIL_CLOSED: no reproducible public current/T-1/T-5 SA3 settlement receipts on one basis.
CHF.licensing_reproducibility: ICE historical EOD listed-market data is distributed via ICE data/report services; a licensed export is required.
CHF.activation_condition: Obtain licensed official SA3 EOD settlements for required buckets on current, T-1 and source-specific T-5, with receipt/timestamp/hash; then run double materialization.

NZD.source_identity: Reserve Bank of New Zealand / NZD OIS market, OCR expectations
NZD.quotation_unit: OCR-linked OIS fixed rate, percent; no public curve observation available for use.
NZD.tenor_mapping: No official/licensed homogeneous NZD OIS curve was supplied; 90-day bank-bill futures and standard bank-bill swaps are explicitly excluded.
NZD.historical_availability: RBNZ publications describe OIS expectations and cite Bloomberg for displayed market expectations; RBNZ public B2 does not publish a reusable OIS curve.
NZD.pit_freshness: FAIL_CLOSED: there are no current/T-1/T-5 official or directly licensed OIS receipts in the repository.
NZD.licensing_reproducibility: Requires an approved directly licensed NZD OIS provider with redistribution/storage rights and immutable daily receipts.
NZD.activation_condition: Onboard licensed NZD OIS curve with contract-level rights, current/T-1/source-specific-T-5 data, timestamps/hashes and deterministic 3M/6M/12M mapping; then run double materialization.
